old: cchāge: the cch is regular sandhi after the vowel of ardhodake; the word is chāge. ardhodaka: milk mixed with half its quantity of water (commentators); the text says only "half water". Identifications: hrīvera = disputed (Pavonia odorata or Plectranthus vettiveroides, Hindi सुगंधबाला, proposed); utpala = blue water-lily, a Nymphaea species, Hindi नीलकमल (standard).
new: cchāge: the cch is the optional doubling of ch after a long vowel (the e of ardhodake); the word is chāge. ardhodaka: milk mixed with half its quantity of water (commentators); the text says only "half water". Identifications: hrīvera = disputed (Pavonia odorata or Plectranthus vettiveroides, Hindi सुगंधबाला, proposed); utpala = blue water-lily, a Nymphaea species, Hindi नीलकमल (standard).
why: reviewer (minor): After a long vowel such as e, doubling ch to cch is optional, not required (it is required only after a short vowel).
